components.name: Any Given Pick Brand Signature
components.description: The abstract route mark and condensed product wordmark used in the desktop rail and mobile brand bar.
components.html: Any GivenPick
components.css: .ds-brand-signature { display: inline-grid; justify-items: center; gap: 0.2rem; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; background: var(--field-950, oklch(21% 0.052 163)); font-family: var(--font-display, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-brand-signature svg { width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; fill: none; stroke: var(--maize, oklch(84% 0.168 94)); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-brand-signature span { display: grid; justify-items: center; line-height: 0.8; } .ds-brand-signature small { color: var(--sage, oklch(69% 0.045 92)); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-brand-signature strong { color: var(--maize, oklch(84% 0.168 94)); font-size: 1.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

components.name: Primary Review Action
components.description: The forward action for reviewing or committing one complete weekly entry.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { width: min(100%, 34rem); min-height: 4.9rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; padding: 0.85rem 2.6rem 0.85rem 1.35rem; border: 0; background: var(--maize, oklch(84% 0.168 94)); color: var(--field-950, oklch(21% 0.052 163)); clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 1.45rem) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 1.45rem) 100%, 0 100%); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-display, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action svg { width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--maize-deep, oklch(76% 0.166 85)); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, oklch(86% 0.17 94)); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary-action { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Text Edit Action

components.name: Team Choice
components.description: An unselected matchup cell optimized for fast abbreviation-first scanning.
components.css: .ds-team-choice { position: relative; min-width: 9rem; min-height: 5.5rem; display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 0.05rem; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0; background: var(--paper-100, oklch(96% 0.021 92)); color: var(--ink, oklch(25% 0.055 163)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-team-choice > span { font-family: var(--font-display, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 2.9rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 0.9; } .ds-team-choice small { color: var(--ink-soft, oklch(42% 0.046 160)); font-family: var(--font-ui, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Verdana, sans-serif); font-size: 0.76rem; } .ds-team-choice:hover { background: var(--paper-200, oklch(91% 0.028 90)); } .ds-team-choice:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-team-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, oklch(86% 0.17 94)); outline-offset: -3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-team-choice { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; width: min(100%, 36rem); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(8rem, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 1.4rem; min-height: 5.6rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; background: var(--field-900, oklch(27% 0.066 162)); color: var(--paper-100, oklch(96% 0.021 92)); } .ds-progress-copy { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.4rem; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-display, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-progress-copy strong { color: var(--maize, oklch(84% 0.168 94)); font-size: 2rem; } .ds-progress-copy span { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-yard-scale { position: relative; height: 1.45rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--paper-200, oklch(91% 0.028 90)); } .ds-yard-scale i { width: 1px; height: 0.55rem; background: var(--paper-200, oklch(91% 0.028 90)); z-index: 1; } .ds-yard-scale i:first-of-type, .ds-yard-scale i:nth-of-type(5), .ds-yard-scale i:last-of-type { height: 1.1rem; } .ds-yard-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 0.82rem; background: var(--maize, oklch(84% 0.168 94)); transform: scaleX(0.625); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 220ms ease-out; } .ds-scale-labels { position: absolute; right: 2rem; bottom: 0.25rem; width: calc(100% - 2rem - 12rem); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: var(--font-display, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 0.8rem; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-yard-fill { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
Any Given Pick turns weekly choices into the feeling of calling a game plan: decisive, legible, tactile, and accountable. Deep field-green framing holds warm paper surfaces, while maize commitments and clay deadline cues make the user's next action unmistakable. The voice is energetic without becoming a sportsbook, and competitive without borrowing official team marks.

The visual hierarchy behaves like a working sideline document rather than a generic dashboard. Condensed uppercase type carries calls, counts, and headings; hyperlegible body text carries explanations and status. Yard-scale measurement, route-diagram linework, clipped tabs, ruled dividers, and check marks provide the football character. These motifs are a reusable vocabulary, not a mandate to repeat the Week 1 composition on every screen.
keyCharacteristics: Deep field-green framing around warm, paper-like task surfaces.
Condensed, uppercase command typography paired with accessible body copy.
Maize reserved for selections, progress, active navigation, and primary actions.
Clay reserved for deadlines, timed drills, and urgent operational cues.
Flat ruled layouts with clipped call-sheet geometry and sparse ambient shadow.
Football energy communicated through abstract play-diagram marks, never licensed team artwork.

rules.name: The Commitment Color Rule
rules.body: Maize means chosen, progressing, active, or ready to commit; do not spend it on passive decoration.

rules.name: The Clay Clock Rule
rules.body: Clay belongs to time pressure and operational emphasis, not selections or generic promotion.

rules.name: The No Sportsbook Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce neon odds colors, financial red/green semantics, dark trading-card chrome, or wagering cues.

rules.name: The Call-and-Explain Rule
rules.body: Condensed type gives the call; hyperlegible type explains what it means.

rules.name: The Short Command Rule
rules.body: Display type is for short, forceful phrases. Never use the compressed uppercase face for paragraphs or legal detail.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: A primary workflow should read as one ordered, scannable sheet; do not fragment it into a mosaic of unrelated cards.

rules.name: The Responsive Subtraction Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, remove secondary detail before shrinking core labels or touch targets.

rules.name: The Ruled-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with tone, borders, and adjacency before adding a shadow.

rules.name: The Clipped Direction Rule
rules.body: Use the angled call-sheet edge only for a choice, deadline, or forward action with clear directionality.

rules.name: The No Soft Card Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce rounded, floating SaaS cards into the core workflow.

dos: Do use Maize only for commitments, active state, progress, and primary actions.
Do pair every selected color state with a check, shape change, label, or other non-color cue.
Do use abstract route lines, yard ticks, whistles, shields, and rule marks to create football character.
Do keep deadlines, eligibility, review, and receipt status in direct, plain language.
Do preserve generous touch targets and visible focus outlines from 360px upward.
Do honor reduced motion by collapsing transitions and disabling smooth scrolling.
donts: Don't resemble a sportsbook: no odds, betting slips, monetary balances, casino glow, or red/green win-loss trading semantics.
Don't depend on NFL logos, team crests, jerseys, or protected team artwork.
Don't scatter the core workflow across rounded floating cards.
Don't use clipped tabs or clay accents as decoration without semantic purpose.
Don't place paragraphs in condensed uppercase type.
Don't shrink essential labels or touch targets to preserve desktop detail on mobile.
